subject: alt-c-pg
title: ALT.C.PG.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in WAC-30, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the diversification of America's utilization of source-transfer-related extension would move to affect the composite reality of the western aesthetic — while at the same time not threaten the vibrational basis of western extension.' (C)ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality): the question is what alternative-composite-progressionalism does once it enters social reality — the structural shape of the Euro-American intervention. ALT-C-PG outputs to SOC-RT (the crossing). SOC-RT then chains: → RT-DY (reality dynamics) → EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) → TR (transformation) → PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism); a *dashed* edge from SOC-RT → LK-IMP (linkage implications) registers that the link to linkage-implications is conditional, not direct; a *dashed* edge from EXP-DYM → TH-CONT (thrust continuance) marks that link as conditional too. ALT-F (alternative functionalism) also feeds SOC-RT, and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) feeds the subject ALT-C-PG. Structural argument: alternative composite progressionalism reaches transformation only via the reality-dynamics → expansion-dynamics chain, with progressional extended functionalism as terminal output. The dashed edges to linkage-implications and thrust-continuance encode the structural worry of the section: the Euro-American extension does not automatically become composite-continuous or thrust-coherent — those connections are conditional, and that conditionality is what makes the project precarious.
